summary:
The impact of lower US production on the Jones Act
The U.S. Flag tanker market has received a boost from the increase in domestic U.S. crude oil production, in particular from tight oil formations in Texas (Eagle Ford and Permian Basin), North Dakota (Bakken) as well as other (smaller) fields.
